subject: POC rollout readiness — owner matrix, acceptance gates, and schedule
messages:
From: Alice Romero <alice.romero@heliobank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Gray <tom.gray@heliobank.com>, procurement@heliobank.com, sec-eng@heliobank.com
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff — aligning attendees and success gates

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Team is keen to kick off the POC; our director wants a short kickoff meeting next week to align owners, timeline, and explicit acceptance gates before we hand this off to pilots. High-level attendees on our side:
- Alice Romero (App Lead)
- Tom Gray (Infrastructure)
- Security engineering (sec-eng@heliobank.com)
- Procurement (procurement@heliobank.com)

Can your team propose a 60–75 minute slot (we prefer mornings PT) and include a short owner matrix + acceptance criteria in advance? Attached is our security RFI mostly for your SE — small PDF.

Goal for the kickoff: mutual action plan, exact test dataset access, and a clear pass/fail checklist for the POC (not just demo success).

Thanks,
Alice
HelioBank — Director, App Platform

Attachment: Helio_Security_RFI.pdf (pdf, 482KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alice Romero <alice.romero@heliobank.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — aligning attendees and success gates

Hi Alice — great to hear. We're ready to run this kickoff. Proposed slots (all PT, 60 min):
- Tue Oct 5 — 9:00–10:00
- Wed Oct 6 — 10:30–11:30
- Thu Oct 7 — 08:30–09:30

Planned Redwood attendees: myself (AE, owner of mutual action plan), Dev Patel (SE, technical lead), Jordan Blake (Customer Success / onboarding). Mina Haddad (Product) will join if we need model/quality conversations; I've CC'd Jordan + Dev so they can confirm.

I'll attach our latest POC playbook and a starter owner matrix. Draft agenda (can update after you confirm):
1) Introductions & success metrics (10m) — Owners: Alice / Marissa
2) Technical plan & data access (20m) — Owner: Dev
3) Security/compliance checklist review (15m) — Owner: Tom / Dev
4) Mutual action plan & next steps (15m) — Owner: Marissa / Procurement

If procurement/security prefer a separate pre-call to accept commercial terms / security scoping, we can schedule that too; otherwise include them in the kickoff.

I'll hold Tue/Wed/Thu windows until I hear back.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: Redwood_POC_playbook_v2.pdf (pptx, 1.2MB)

On Fri, Oct 1, 2027 at 10:05 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> I'll attach our latest POC playbook and a starter owner matrix. Draft agenda (can update after you confirm):

Quick tech note from my side: for the hands-on testing we will need a service account with read-only access to a representative dataset (S3 link or equivalent) and a small VPN exception for streaming logs back to our diagnostics collector. If Helio has any sandbox tokens that would be ideal.

Suggested acceptance gates (short, binary where possible):
- Latency: 95th percentile < 800ms for sample-run (50k tokens/day)
- Quality: model responses meet 80% pass rate on your evaluation set (we can run a blind eval)
- Security: no PII leakage from sample dataset per the RFI checks
- Integration: data pipeline can push/consume pre-signed URLs or SFTP by week 2

I can own the technical checklist and run the first integration test within 48 hours of data access.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com

Note: forwarding Helio's RFI to our security team internally for pre-checks.
